title: Size of a gate circuit
statement: For every natural number $n$, every Boolean gate type (AND or OR), and every list $cs$ of circuits on $n$ variables, the circuit with that gate and children $cs$ has size $1$ plus the sum of the sizes of the circuits in $cs$.
hypotheses_covered: $cs$ is a list of Boolean circuits on $n$ variables
